description: Count, share, trend: answers, share named / recommended / first, position, tone and treatment mix, citations, pages and sites cited, comparisons won and lost (one brand: subject), search_reach (a brand's sites in retrieved result lists; no by), memory_gap (a brand named with search on against search off, on the questions both answered; no by) and concentration (answers naming the top 1, 3, 5 brands; no by; list_facets has each measure's evidence). Group by brand, topic, market, question, engine, surface_class, day, week, month, site, page, page_type, axis, versus_brand; by brand takes answers, shares, position, tone and treatment, not citations or comparisons (those take a subject). brands: [ids] lists just those brands. Numbers cover the counted engines unless filter.engine or filter.surfaceClass says otherwise, or by names engine or surface_class (context.surfaces says which). Every cell has its answers, questions and a 95% range; compare: prior adds the matched change and significance; by week or month gives the matched trend. Free: with credits every row; without, samples and aggregates (own brands in full).

brands.description: with by brand: only these brands' rows, against each other in the same answers (in place of the most named)

by.description: up to 3 of brand, topic, market, question, engine, surface_class, place, country, day, week, month, site, page, page_type, axis, versus_brand, or facet:<key>

compare.description: prior: the window of equal length before, with significance; none: no comparison. Write the value bare, compare: prior, with no quotes inside the string

explain.description: true: one plain sentence saying what the reply shows. change (with subject, a share and compare prior): why each share moved, split into the same questions and the question mix, with engine model changes

fields.description: columns to keep in each row

filter.description: which answers count; window is a separate argument, not part of filter

brand.description: brd_ ids; with brandRule, which answers count

brandRule.description: default named; warned: the answer advises against the brand by the caution-insight rule (warnsAgainst: the judge's advised_against at least 0.65 and the brand not only a cited source; list_facets: mention.advised_against). It misses most warnings (recall 0.34) and is NOT the app's Answers page rule, which reads the judged treatment warned_against (list_facets: mention.treatment)

country.description: ISO country codes the question was asked from; an answer asked with no place set counts as US

engine.description: surface ids (list_facets: engine); without engine or surfaceClass, the counted engines

place.description: plc_ ids (resolve_ids finds them): the place a question is about, with the places under each (a region holds its cities). "all": every place, in place of a local subject's area. A country code here reads as filter.country for one release

scope.description: default all: public plus this workspace's own; own: only the answers this workspace bought; tracked: its own answers and those about the questions, topics and brands it watches with the track tool (not the brands it added in the app); public: public answers only

site.description: domains or site: ids of cited sites

surfaceClass.description: classes of engines to cover; default counted

text.description: Full-text search over answer text: keywords, "exact phrases", AND/OR/NOT, NEAR/n, prefix*. A call reads at most the first 100,000 matches (20,000 in search_answers) before the brand filter and the rest apply: a brand filter does not narrow it, so a common word over a long window can miss a brand's answers; narrow by window, topic, market or engine

level.description: how brands count: company (default; a company and its products are one brand) or product (each brand on its own, so a product's numbers leave out its siblings)

panel.description: changes on matched questions (default) or every question

sort.description: a measure or a by dimension; "<name> asc" or "<name> desc"

subject.description: brd_ id the shares are about; or group by brand. With no filter it reads the brand's own markets (up to three) pooled, named in context.marketsRead: pass filter.market for one market's number

window.description: default the last 28 days; "last" or from/to

name: query_metrics
title: Query metrics over AI answers
